record.original_question: Let F be a Fuchsian group in D, and let B be a set on T such that B ∩ γ(B) = ∅ for γ ∈ Γ, γ 6= I. (This is the case, for instance, if B = (∂F ∩ T) \ C (C countable) where F is a normal fundamental domain.) If cap B > 0, does it follow that F is of convergence type? (Conversely, it is known that, for every group F of convergence type, there exists such a set B with cap B > 0). (Ch. Pommerenke)

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\mathbb{D}=\{z\in\mathbb{C}:|z|<1\}$ denote the open unit disc and $\mathbb{T}=\partial\mathbb{D}$ the unit circle. Let $\Gamma$ be a Fuchsian group acting on $\mathbb{D}$ (a discrete group of Möbius transformations of $\mathbb{D}$ onto itself). The group $\Gamma$ is said to be of convergence type if
$$\sum_{\gamma\in\Gamma}(1-|\gamma(0)|)<\infty,$$
and of divergence type otherwise.

For a set $E\subset\mathbb{T}$, let $\operatorname{cap} E$ denote its logarithmic capacity.

Suppose $B\subset\mathbb{T}$ is a Borel set such that
$$B\cap\gamma(B)=\emptyset\quad\text{for every }\gamma\in\Gamma\setminus\{I\}.$$
(For example, this holds when $B=(\partial F\cap\mathbb{T})\setminus C$ for a countable set $C$, where $F$ is a normal fundamental domain for $\Gamma$.)

Question: If $\operatorname{cap} B>0$, does it follow that $\Gamma$ is of convergence type?

(It is already known that, conversely, for every Fuchsian group of convergence type there exists such a set $B\subset\mathbb{T}$ with $\operatorname{cap} B>0$.)
artifact.status_search_result: A web search surfaced related work by Pommerenke on Fuchsian groups of convergence/divergence type (e.g., his papers on Green's functions of Fuchsian groups and on Fuchsian groups of divergence type) but no source explicitly resolving the converse question of whether positive capacity of a packing set $B\subset\mathbb{T}$ forces the group to be of convergence type. The status of this specific problem could not be verified from the search.

status_evidence.title: On Fuchsian groups of divergence type — Pommerenke
status_evidence.snippet: Pommerenke published work on Fuchsian groups of divergence type in the Michigan Mathematical Journal (1981).
status_evidence.claim: Related work by Pommerenke exists on convergence/divergence type Fuchsian groups, but no resolution to the converse capacity question was located.

status_evidence.title: Fuchsian groups from the dynamical viewpoint
status_evidence.snippet: Research on the structure of Fuchsian groups due to Hopf, Hedlund, Sullivan, Nicholls, Pommerenke, and others.
status_evidence.claim: The topic remains an active area but no explicit solution to the stated converse was found.
